lines.en: I swing my arms and stride along.

lines.zh: 我边走边掂量脚下的力道。
lines.en: I test the strength of my steps as I go.
I take a lap of the floor to warm up.

lines.zh: 我踩过地板，木头轻轻响。
lines.en: The floorboards creak under my feet.

lines.zh: 我走得轻快，像要去吃饭。
lines.en: I walk briskly, as if heading to dinner.

lines.zh: 我抬头看梁，想着跳上去。
lines.en: I look up at the beams, thinking of jumping.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上两步跨下去。
lines.en: I take the steps two at a time.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边活动手腕。
lines.en: I roll my wrists as I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的鞋带，弯腰系。
lines.en: I step on my lace and stoop to tie it.

lines.zh: 我在柱子边停了一下又走。
lines.en: I pause by a pillar and move on.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方都带点风。
lines.en: A breeze follows where I walk.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但步子很大。
lines.en: I do not hurry, but my strides are long.

lines.zh: 我绕着石桌转，看看有没有吃的。
lines.en: I circle the stone table, looking for food.

lines.zh: 我折回来，忘了自己要干嘛。
lines.en: I turn back, having forgotten why I walked.
I stand with my hands on my hips.
I stare at the far clouds.
Good moment to hold a stance.
I scratch the back of my neck; it itches.
I count the pillars: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，感觉体内的东西。
lines.en: I hold my breath and feel the power inside.
I retie my wrist wraps.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，可随时能跳。
lines.en: I stand still, ready to leap at any moment.
I throw half a punch at empty air.
I am thinking of that opponent again.
Hey, you made it!
You look well today.
Hold on, let me have a look at you.
Your ki is brighter than last time.
How about two laps first?
That build of yours can be trained.
No need to be formal; sit and talk.

lines.zh: 你眼睛在发亮，想学什么？
lines.en: Your eyes are shining; what do you want to learn?

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，拍拍你的肩。
lines.en: I grin and clap your shoulder.
Throw one punch for me.
You stand too stiff; loosen up.
I am not that frightening, am I?
Are you hungry? I have food.

lines.zh: 我们有的是时间，慢慢来。
lines.en: We have plenty of time; take it slow.
Your knuckles have not been hardened yet.
This place is fine, but there are no mountains.
Ouch, that one stung.
I rub the spot and laugh.
Not bad; you hit hard.
Half a step back, plant my feet, again.
This will heal in a moment.
I grin, and it only fires me up.
Pain is good; it means you meant it.
I shake my hand; the joint still clicks.
I suppose I must return the favour.
Don't worry; I am tough.
Food? Give it here!

lines.zh: 这一顿吃完再练也来得及。
lines.en: We can train after I finish this.
My stomach said yes first.
Don't tease me; I will take it seriously.

lines.zh: 这碗太小了，能再来一份吗。
lines.en: This bowl is small; can I have another?
I will listen while I eat.
Good, this is really good.
Training needs food, or there is no strength.

lines.zh: 你留着点，我一会儿还要。
lines.en: Save some; I will want more later.
Oops, we bumped.
You are pretty solid.
My pace was too quick; my bad.
A bump is nothing; let's go.
The floor rang when we hit.
Steady there; let me help you.
That felt like hitting stone.
I step back; you go first.
Don't stand in the middle of the walkway.
Good, no one is hurt.
Huh? I don't really understand that.
I only know training and eating.

lines.zh: 你问别人吧，我答不上来。
lines.en: Ask someone else; I cannot answer.
I scratch my head and laugh awkwardly.
You would have to ask Chi-Chi.

lines.zh: 我连自己的事都弄不清。
lines.en: I cannot even sort out my own affairs.
Change the subject; teach me a move.
I wave a hand and let it pass.
Let's just train.
I have honestly never thought about it.
I pick it up and brush off the dust.
Can I eat this? No? Never mind.
My belt has room for one more.
Things dropped should be picked up.
This is heavy; interesting.
Is this yours? Take it.
I carried it so long I nearly forgot.
This hand could hold two of you.
Put it away; don't drop it again.
All right, here we go; I am serious now.
I have caught your ki.
Stand ready; I am coming.
I have waited a long time for this.
I drop low and shift my weight forward.
No dodging now; come on.
Your stance is good; keep it.
I watch your shoulder, not your hands.
I will remember this bout.
I raise a hand, palm toward you.
I have matched your steps.
Your left foot is heavy; I noticed.
I circle, in no hurry to strike.
Your ki is drifting right; mind it.
I stand fixed like a nail.
The distance is right; I can reach any time.
Back up more and you hit the wall.
Your breathing is off; slow down.
I follow you around three steps.

lines.zh: 这一招你练过，我看得出。
lines.en: You have drilled this move; I can see.
This punch, I am holding back.
Take it! Don't shut your eyes.
My palm lands on your shoulder, light.
Good block; again.
My leg sweeps past your knees.

lines.zh: 这一下打得地板都裂了缝。
lines.en: That blow cracked the floor.
I turn and punch, half a beat faster.
You back two steps; hold your ground.
I stop, afraid of really hurting you.
Good; you have learned this move.

lines.zh: 我落地，膝盖一弯就站直。
lines.en: I land, bend my knees, and rise.
The temple is where I was placed.
I stretch out fully.
I wake and immediately want to move.

lines.zh: 这里的地板挺硬，跳着舒服。
lines.en: The floor is hard; nice for jumping.
Good light for training.
First, let me see if there is an opponent.
So quiet; I will run a form.
I test my own weight.
My stomach growls first; a little awkward.
Hot! I slap the fire off my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，揉了揉腰。
lines.en: I fall from a height and rub my back.

lines.zh: 水里憋不住，我挣着往上游。
lines.en: I cannot hold my breath and fight upward.
The blast slides me across the floor.

lines.zh: 石子打中我的额头，弹开。
lines.en: A stone hits my forehead and bounces off.

lines.zh: 这股力怪怪的，压着我不放。
lines.en: This force is strange and will not let go.
No meal, and my fists feel soft.

lines.zh: 电得我头发都竖起来了。
lines.en: The shock stands my hair on end.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，还在找落脚点。
lines.en: I fall, still looking for something to land on.
